constant.name: Speed of Light in Vacuum
constant.Description: Speed of all electromagnetic waves in vacuum.

constant.name: Vacuum permittivity
constant.Description: An electric constant describing the capability of a vacuum to permit electric field lines; relates electric charge to electric fields.

constant.name: Vacuum permeability
constant.Description: Magnetic constant (about 4π×10⁻⁷). Related to c by c² = 1/(ε₀μ₀).

constant.name: Planck constant
constant.description: Relates photon energy and frequency: E = hf.

constant.name: pi
constant.description: Ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.

constant.description: Magnitude of the charge of a proton or electron.
